name: The silent rover
briefing: Echo's power bus failed during a survey. Restore the surface relay, recover the rover, and bring its research home to Haven.
classification: Authored educational scenario. Crew, hardware, structures, failures and equipment parameters are fictional. Terrain and celestial vectors come from NASA/JPL.

physics.classification: Rounded lunar physical constant; used by the jump animation.

art.artisticLighting: Illustrative fixed light direction, not a computed lunar illumination product. Structures and small decorative rocks are illustrations.

assumptions: Mission time runs at 10 times wall-clock time. Pause, briefing and repair puzzle screens freeze mission time.
Oxygen is represented as equivalent minutes at a nominal draw. Walking, slope and sprinting change that draw. No medical or operational EVA safety claim is made.
Vehicle, suit and water parameters are editable teaching assumptions, not specifications for flight hardware.
Routes use slopes from the averaged DEM, 8-neighbour graph traversal, and fictional equipment slope limits. Sub-grid hazards are not resolved.
The Lifeline is a conservative educational estimate using the selected route, nominal movement rates and a 20 percent return reserve.
Terrain is in a lunar body-fixed frame. The orbital view uses Moon-centred ICRF vectors; the two views are not merged into an operational navigation solution.
